title: High-Frequency Market Making to Large Institutional Trades
one_line: More HFT activity raises execution costs for large institutional trades (especially informed ones); about two-thirds of HFT competition is inventory management and one-third back-running.

findings.statement: Increased HFT activity → higher institutional execution costs (regulatory shock identification).
HFTs back-run using past prices and trade/limit-order imbalances.

reported_results.headline: More HFT activity raises execution costs for large institutional trades (especially informed ones); about two-thirds of HFT competition is inventory management and one-third back-running.

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 3), not by the weekly pipeline.
